title: Improved ecliptic leaves seasons
description: This ressource pack improves leaves of ecliptic seasons!
body:
HELLO!!! This texture pack was inspired by Ecliptic Seasons!



This texture pack changes leaves realisitically as solar terms progress, I really hope you liked it! I put lot of effort in it!


Available Leaves: Oak, Birch, Spruce, Dark Oak and Cherry

Currently, we're working on other types of leaves!

This texture pack is availabe for 1.21.x, the required mod is Ecliptic Seasons 1.21.x

The verison of this ressource pack is 1.4

WARNING: THIS RESSOURCE PACK IS WIP

ALSO AVAILABLE ON PLANET MINECRAFT!
